_instructions: This file holds the key material the tool uses. Each entry under 'profiles'
is one recovered key set. To use the tool on YOUR target, do the following:
1. Decompile the target binary and find its crypto/helper class.
2. Recover the KEY and IV byte arrays, and note the cipher (des or rc2)
3. Add a profile below: give it a name, fill in key/iv as hex bytes.
4. Delete the example profiles you don't need.
description : free text, shown by --list. Put the source here.
key / iv    : hex bytes. Spaces, commas, or 0x prefixes are all fine.
Lines starting with '_' are comments and are ignored by the tool.

example-des-cbc._comment: EXAMPLE ONLY - replace with your own recovered key/iv, or delete.

example-rc2-cbc._comment: EXAMPLE ONLY - replace with your own recovered key/iv, or delete.
